title: Login to the Hospital Management Portal
description: Allows users to log in to the system using their credentials, with options for new user registration and password recovery.

steps.value: The user navigates to the Hospital Management Portal and lands on the login page.
The user enters their registered email address or username into the 'Email/Username' field.
The user enters their password into the 'Password' field.
The user clicks the 'Login' button.
If login is successful:
subitems: If the user has a single assigned role, they are redirected to the landing page for that specific role.
If the user has multiple assigned roles, they are redirected to a 'Role Selection' page to choose their active role for the session.

steps.value: If login fails due to incorrect credentials, an error message is displayed.
The user can click 'Sign Up' to navigate to the registration page for new accounts.
The user can click 'Forgot Password' to initiate the password recovery process.

title: Sign Up for a New Account
description: Enables new users to register for an account, primarily for the patient role, and verifies their email address.

steps.value: The user navigates to the 'Sign Up' page, typically by clicking a link on the login page.
The user enters their first name, last name, email address, and desired password.
The user confirms their password.
The user selects their role from a dropdown list. Based on onboarding rules, only 'patient' role is available for self-signup.
The user reviews and accepts the terms of service and privacy policy.
The user clicks the 'Register' or 'Sign Up' button.
The system sends a verification email to the provided email address.
The user is redirected to a confirmation page, instructing them to check their email (including spam folder) to verify their account.

title: Forgot Password
description: Allows users to request a password reset link to their registered email address.

steps.value: The user navigates to the 'Forgot Password' page, typically by clicking a link on the login page.
The user enters their registered email address into the designated field.
The user clicks the 'Send Reset Link' or 'Submit' button.
The system sends a password reset link to the provided email address.
The user is redirected to a confirmation page, instructing them to check their email for the reset link.

title: Reset Password
description: Enables users to set a new password after receiving a password reset link via email.

steps.value: The user clicks on the password reset link received in their email, which directs them to the 'Reset Password' page.
The user enters their new desired password into the 'New Password' field.
The user confirms their new password by re-entering it into the 'Confirm New Password' field.
The user clicks the 'Reset Password' button.
If the password reset is successful, the user is redirected to the login page with a success message, prompting them to log in with their new password.
If the reset link is expired or invalid, an appropriate error message is displayed.

title: View Admin Dashboard
description: Provides an overview of the hospital's operational metrics and quick access to administrative functions. This is the primary landing page for administrators.

steps.value: Login leads to Admin Dashboard (or Role Selection, then Admin Dashboard).
The dashboard displays key performance indicators (KPIs) such as total patients, active doctors, upcoming appointments, and recent system activities.
Navigation links or widgets provide quick access to User Management, Hospital Configuration, Reporting, and Appointment Oversight.

title: Manage System Users (Patients, Doctors, and Admins)
description: Allows administrators to create, view, edit, and deactivate user accounts for patients, doctors, and other administrators, and assign/modify user roles.

steps.value: Navigate to the User Management section from the Admin Dashboard.
View a list of all registered users (patients, doctors, admins).
Use search and filter options to find specific users by name, role, or status.
To add a new user (Doctor or Admin):
subitems: Click 'Add New User'.
Enter user details (name, email, contact, etc.).
Select the appropriate role(s) (Doctor, Admin).
Submit to create the user account.

steps.value: To edit an existing user:
subitems: Select a user from the list.
Modify user details, including personal information and assigned roles.
Save changes.

steps.value: To deactivate a user:
subitems: Select a user from the list.
Confirm deactivation.

steps.value: To view a patient's profile:
subitems: Select a patient from the list.
View their personal and contact information.

title: Configure Hospital System Settings
description: Enables administrators to manage system-wide settings such as hospital operating hours, holidays, and specific operational policies.

steps.value: Navigate to the System Configuration section from the Admin Dashboard.
View current hospital-wide settings.
Edit general information like hospital name and contact details.
Modify operating hours (e.g., daily schedule, weekend hours).
Add, edit, or remove hospital holidays.
Update or add new operational policies.
Save all configuration changes.
View an audit log of past configuration changes.

title: Generate and View Operational Reports
description: Allows administrators to generate and view various reports on key operational metrics such as appointment volumes, user engagement, and communication statistics, with export capabilities.

steps.value: Navigate to the Reporting & Analytics section from the Admin Dashboard.
Select a report category (e.g., Appointments, User Activity, Messaging).
Choose specific report parameters (e.g., date range, doctor, patient, status).
Click 'Generate Report'.
View the generated report, which may include charts, graphs, and detailed tables.
Option to export the report data in formats like CSV or PDF.

title: Oversee All Hospital Appointments
description: Provides administrators with a comprehensive view of all scheduled, pending, and completed appointments across the hospital, with options to manage them.

steps.value: Navigate to the Appointment Management section from the Admin Dashboard.
View a consolidated list of all appointments.
Filter appointments by various criteria (e.g., date range, doctor, patient, status: pending, confirmed, cancelled, completed).
Search for specific appointments.
Select an appointment to view its detailed information (patient, doctor, time, reason).
Option to manually confirm, reschedule, or cancel an appointment.
View appointment history and audit trails.

title: Process Patient Data Rights Requests
description: Facilitates administrators in handling patient requests for data access, correction, or deletion, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations.

steps.value: Navigate to the Data Rights Management section (or a dedicated area within User Management) from the Admin Dashboard.
View a list of all pending patient data rights requests.
Select a specific request to review its details (patient, request type, date).
Initiate the internal workflow to fulfill the request (e.g., generate data export for access, open a ticket for correction, confirm deletion).
Update the status of the request (e.g., 'In Progress', 'Completed', 'Rejected').
Communicate with the patient regarding the status or outcome of their request.

title: View Patient Medical Records for Oversight
description: Allows administrators to view patient medical records for auditing, support, or data integrity monitoring purposes, while adhering to strict access controls.

steps.value: Navigate to the Medical Records section (potentially via Patient Profile in User Management) from the Admin Dashboard.
Search for a specific patient.
Select the patient to access their profile.
Navigate to the Medical Records tab or section within the patient's profile.
View a list of all medical record entries for that patient.
Select an entry to view its detailed content (diagnosis, treatment, medications, visit summary).

title: Patient Dashboard Overview
description: The main landing page for patients, providing a summary of their health information and quick access to key functionalities.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard (or Role Selection, then Patient Dashboard).
View a personalized greeting.
See a summary of upcoming appointments.
View recent messages from doctors.
Access quick links to 'My Profile', 'Appointments', 'Medical Records', and 'Messages'.
View any important notifications or alerts.

title: Manage Personal Profile
description: Patients can view and update their personal information, contact details, emergency contacts, and demographic data.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'My Profile' section.
View current personal details (name, date of birth, contact number, email, address).
Click 'Edit Profile' to modify information.
Update fields such as contact number, email, address.
Add or edit emergency contact details.
Submit changes.
View confirmation of successful update.

title: View My Appointments
description: Patients can view a list of their upcoming, past, and cancelled appointments.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'My Appointments' section.
View a list of all appointments, categorized by status (Upcoming, Past, Cancelled).
Select an appointment to view detailed information (doctor, date, time, reason).

title: Schedule a New Appointment
description: Patients can schedule new appointments with available doctors.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'My Appointments' section.
Click 'Schedule New Appointment'.
Select a doctor or specialty.
View available dates and time slots for the selected doctor/specialty.
Select a preferred date and time slot.
Enter the reason for the visit.
Review appointment details.
Click 'Confirm Appointment'.
Receive confirmation of the scheduled appointment.

title: Reschedule an Existing Appointment
description: Patients can change the date and time of their upcoming appointments.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'My Appointments' section.
From the 'Upcoming Appointments' list, select the appointment to reschedule.
Click 'Reschedule'.
View available dates and time slots for the same doctor.
Select a new preferred date and time slot.
Confirm the rescheduling.
Receive confirmation of the rescheduled appointment.

title: Cancel an Existing Appointment
description: Patients can cancel their upcoming appointments.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'My Appointments' section.
From the 'Upcoming Appointments' list, select the appointment to cancel.
Click 'Cancel Appointment'.
Confirm the cancellation.
Receive confirmation of the cancelled appointment.

title: View My Medical Records
description: Patients can securely access and view their personal medical records and visit summaries.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'Medical Records' section.
View a chronological list of medical records (e.g., visit summaries, lab results, diagnoses).
Select a specific record to view its detailed content (date, doctor, diagnosis, treatment, medications, visit summary).
Option to download or print a record.

title: View Secure Messages
description: Patients can view secure messages exchanged with their doctors.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'Messages' section.
View an inbox of secure messages, possibly categorized by doctor or conversation.
Select a message to open and read its content.
View message details (sender, timestamp, subject).

title: Send a Secure Message to Doctor
description: Patients can compose and send new secure messages to their assigned doctors.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'Messages' section.
Click 'Compose New Message'.
Select the doctor to send the message to (from a list of assigned doctors).
Enter a subject for the message.
Type the message content.
Click 'Send Message'.
View confirmation that the message has been sent.

title: Manage Data Rights Requests
description: Patients can submit requests for access, correction, or deletion of their personal and medical data.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'Privacy & Data Rights' section (or similar).
View options to request data access, data correction, or data deletion.
Select a request type (e.g., 'Request Data Access').
Provide necessary details or justification for the request.
Submit the request.
View the status of submitted data rights requests.

title: Manage Consent Preferences
description: Patients can review and update their consent preferences for data usage and privacy policies.

steps.value: Login leads to Patient Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'Consent Management' section.
View a list of different consent types (e.g., marketing, data sharing, research).
For each consent type, view its current status (granted/denied).
Click to review details of a specific consent policy.
Toggle or select options to grant or revoke consent.
Save changes to consent preferences.
View confirmation of updated consent.

title: Doctor Dashboard Overview
description: The primary landing page for doctors, providing a consolidated view of their clinical schedule, pending appointments, and quick access to patient records and messages.

steps.value: Login leads to Doctor Dashboard (or Role Selection, then Doctor Dashboard).
The dashboard displays the doctor's daily or weekly clinical schedule.
View a summary of pending appointment requests from patients.
Access quick links to 'My Schedule', 'Patient Records', and 'Messages'.
View any important notifications or alerts related to patient care or system updates.

title: Manage Doctor's Appointments and Schedule
description: Allows doctors to view their schedule, confirm or reject new appointment requests, and manage existing appointments (reschedule/cancel).

steps.value: Login leads to Doctor Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'My Schedule' or 'Appointment Management' section.
View a calendar or list of all scheduled appointments.
View a list of pending appointment requests from patients.
For a pending request:
subitems: Review patient details and reason for visit.
Click 'Confirm' to accept the appointment.
Click 'Reject' to decline the appointment, optionally providing a reason.

steps.value: For an existing appointment:
subitems: Select an appointment to view its detailed information (patient, date, time, reason).
Click 'Reschedule' to change the date/time, selecting from available slots.
Click 'Cancel' to cancel the appointment, optionally providing a reason.

title: View Patient Medical Records
description: Enables doctors to securely access and review the medical records of their assigned patients or patients with active appointments.

steps.value: Login leads to Doctor Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'Patient Records' section or select a patient from an appointment.
Search for a specific patient by name or ID.
Select a patient from the search results or list of assigned patients.
View the patient's profile information.
Access the 'Medical Records' tab or section within the patient's profile.
View a chronological list of medical record entries (e.g., visit summaries, lab results, diagnoses, treatments, medications).
Select a specific record entry to view its detailed content.

title: Update Patient Medical Records (EHR)
description: Allows doctors to add new entries or update existing information in a patient's Electronic Health Record (EHR), ensuring data integrity and compliance.

steps.value: Login leads to Doctor Dashboard.
Navigate to a patient's medical records (via 'doctorViewPatientMedicalRecords' scenario).
Click 'Add New Entry' or select an existing entry to edit.
Enter or update details such as diagnosis, treatment plan, medications, and visit summary.
Attach relevant files or lab results if applicable.
Review the entered information for accuracy.
Click 'Save' or 'Submit' to apply changes, triggering data validation.
Receive confirmation of successful record update.

title: View Secure Messages from Patients
description: Doctors can view secure, encrypted messages sent by their patients.

steps.value: Login leads to Doctor Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'Messages' section.
View an inbox of secure messages, possibly categorized by patient or conversation.
Select a message to open and read its content.
View message details (sender, timestamp, subject).

title: Send a Secure Message to Patient
description: Doctors can compose and send new secure messages to their patients.

steps.value: Login leads to Doctor Dashboard.
Navigate to the 'Messages' section.
Click 'Compose New Message'.
Select the patient to send the message to (from a list of assigned patients).
Enter a subject for the message.
Type the message content.
Click 'Send Message'.
View confirmation that the message has been sent.

title: Interact with Clinical Assistant AI
description: Doctors can leverage an AI assistant to quickly summarize patient history, retrieve clinical data, or draft patient communications.

steps.value: Login leads to Doctor Dashboard.
Access the 'Clinical Assistant AI' feature, possibly from the dashboard or within a patient's record.
To get a patient summary:
subitems: Select a patient.
Input a query like 'Summarize patient's medical history' or 'Show recent diagnoses'.
View the AI-generated summary or retrieved data.

steps.value: To draft a secure message:
subitems: Select a patient.
Input a prompt like 'Draft a message to patient X explaining their lab results' or 'Suggest a follow-up message'.
Review the AI-generated draft message.
Edit the message as needed and then send it (leading to 'doctorSendSecureMessage' scenario).

title: Select Application Role
description: Allows an authenticated user with multiple assigned application roles (e.g., Patient, Doctor) to select which role they want to operate as for the current session after successful login.

steps.value: Login leads to Role Selection if the user has multiple assigned application roles.
The system displays a list of application roles assigned to the user (e.g., Patient, Doctor, Admin).
The user selects one of the available roles from the list.
Upon selection, the user is redirected to the primary landing page specific to the chosen role (e.g., Patient Dashboard, Doctor Dashboard, or Admin Dashboard).
